responsibilities.responsibility: Own one durable browser/OAuth login attempt across pending polls, cancellation, timeout, process death and cold start without consuming a pending attempt or accepting a stale/foreign callback.
responsibilities.visible_effect: Login can remain pending across multiple polls and app process restart, then settle once or be cancelled/expired.
responsibilities.cancellation_behavior: Cancel clears the local durable attempt before best-effort backend cancellation; terminal state cannot later be consumed again.
responsibilities.retry_semantics: Poll preserves the same attempt while pending; caller follows bounded pollAfterMs and expiry instead of creating a second attempt.
responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: At most one active attempt is owned locally; terminal settlement removes its durable record and duplicate/stale ids fail closed.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Host reloads account-oauth-attempt.json on cold start, validates origin/expiry and resumes the same backend attempt.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Attempt settlement remains inside current Host/account owner; broader account-epoch callback fencing remains required before verification.
responsibilities.security_boundary: pollSecret is persisted only in private Host app data and never projected to Presentation; Custom Tabs URL must be canonical HTTPS origin.

responsibilities.platform_delta: Desktop browser auth becomes system Custom Tabs; attempt identity/poll secret stay in Rust Host durable state rather than Activity/ViewModel.

responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: Artifact identity is pluginId+version+artifactId+sha256; active pointer changes atomically.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Installed immutable versions and active pointer survive process death; interrupted staging is not treated as active.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Marketplace fetch is account-scoped upstream; installed package identity is local canonical Host state and must be rechecked at account policy boundaries.
responsibilities.security_boundary: Only validated public immutable sources are accepted; Mini App does not choose arbitrary local executable paths or self-grant permissions.
responsibilities.platform_delta: Portable Rust installer is copied at exact Desktop blob; Android selects only artifacts declaring platform=android and uses app-private plugin storage.
responsibilities.production_wiring: feature.plugin.install now uses canonical PluginInstaller in production; deterministic Test mode remains an explicit fixture only.
responsibilities.unit_test: Canonical Desktop PluginInstaller tests vendored unchanged; Host invalid-manifest contract updated; exact-head Actions pending
responsibilities.contract_test: Cargo workspace/Host contract on new exact HEAD required
responsibilities.integration_test: Real marketplace release install and restart recovery required
responsibilities.packaged_test: Final ciAcceptance/githubRelease package path must exercise the same Host installer
responsibilities.device_test: Emulator/device install acceptance required after protected session is available
responsibilities.notes: Exact Desktop source blob preserved. JS/WASM/MCP execution is a separate responsibility and remains fail-closed.

responsibilities.responsibility: Persist explicit least-privilege plugin grants, reject permissions not declared by the installed release, revoke durably, and prune grants when a new release stops requesting them.
responsibilities.visible_effect: User-approved plugin permissions persist across restart but cannot exceed the installed release declaration.
responsibilities.cancellation_behavior: Revocation is durable and takes effect before future runtime execution; there is no UI-only grant owner.
responsibilities.retry_semantics: Duplicate grant converges in the set; duplicate revoke is harmless persistence of the absent grant.
responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: Permission key is plugin identity + exact permission; release reconciliation retains only still-requested grants.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Permission JSON reloads in Host after process death; install reconciles stale grants against current requested permissions.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Future runtime calls must additionally bind active account/session where capability is account-scoped; grant alone never authorizes a side effect.
responsibilities.security_boundary: Compose cannot mutate the store directly; PermissionManager is necessary but not sufficient for Capability Broker execution authorization.
responsibilities.platform_delta: Platform-independent permission store stays Rust; Android UI only requests grant/revoke through typed Coordinator/JNI Host dispatch.
responsibilities.production_wiring: plugin.permission.grant/revoke use canonical PermissionManager and active installed release requestedPermissions; install prunes stale grants.
responsibilities.unit_test: Canonical PermissionManager tests vendored; Host uninstalled-plugin rejection contract updated; exact-head Actions pending
responsibilities.contract_test: Rust workspace/Host tests required on new exact HEAD
responsibilities.integration_test: Permission grant/revoke/restart and Mini App non-escalation journey required
responsibilities.packaged_test: Final packaged acceptance must prove same production Host path
responsibilities.notes: Not verified until runtime execution demonstrates Capability Broker also consumes/rechecks grants at the actual side-effect boundary.

responsibilities.responsibility: Own portable runtime start/stop, service/tool registration, runtime.call cancellation/timeout, effect disposal, reconnect and process-recovery semantics with Capability Broker enforcement at execution.
responsibilities.source_owner: Mahayana runtime lifecycle/service graph plus runtime-specific adapters
responsibilities.state_owner: Host runtime supervisor (target); currently no executable adapter
responsibilities.visible_effect: Installed portable plugins can actually start, expose tools and execute calls without Mini App privilege escalation.
responsibilities.cancellation_behavior: Stop/dispose cancels pending effects; completion/cancellation race has one terminal outcome.
responsibilities.retry_semantics: No blind replay of unknown side effects; reconnect/restart reconciles durable intent with actual runtime state.
responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: Call/request IDs and runtime instance generation fence duplicates and stale results.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Must reconstruct the same durable runtime intent after process death and reconcile pending side effects rather than silently rerun.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Account-scoped tool execution requires current account epoch/session proof on every side-effect boundary.
responsibilities.security_boundary: Capability Broker consumes/rechecks explicit grants; Mini App surface identity/nonce cannot mint additional capability.
responsibilities.android_owner: Rust Host runtime supervisor + runtime-specific adapter behind Capability Broker
responsibilities.platform_delta: PluginSupervisor primitive is portable, but Android still needs a real executable JS/WASM/MCP adapter rather than desktop process assumptions.
responsibilities.production_wiring: runtime.start/stop/tools use DeepSeekJsHost; runtime.call now executes real call_tool_json only after Capability Broker validation of immutable install, declared permission, persisted grant, plugin-scoped registration, stable requestId, account fence and runtime generation. stop/revoke settle pending calls cancelled; restart turns in-flight calls into outcome-unknown.
responsibilities.unit_test: Canonical JS runtime tests plus Android Host CapabilityBroker tests; exact-head Actions required.
responsibilities.contract_test: runtime.call fail-closed boundary implemented; duplicate/stale/restart semantics covered in Rust unit tests. True asynchronous timeout/cancel preemption remains open.
responsibilities.notes: Production execution is no longer hard-coded fail-closed. The synchronous QuickJS adapter cannot yet be interrupted while inside call_tool_json; bounded deadline is enforced before/after execution and any late return is outcome-unknown/reconciliation, so this row remains not-verified.
